visual_phrases.round_neck: round crew neckline, circular curved neckline opening, NOT a V-neck, no V-shaped neckline, no pointed neckline
visual_phrases.square_neck: square-shaped neckline with straight horizontal top edge and straight vertical sides
visual_phrases.boat_neck: wide horizontal boat neckline extending toward the shoulders
visual_phrases.high_neck: high neckline rising around the base of the neck
visual_phrases.off_shoulder: neckline positioned below both shoulders, exposing both shoulders
visual_phrases.sweetheart_neck: heart-shaped sweetheart neckline with a central dip
visual_phrases.halter_neck: halter neckline wrapping around the neck with shoulders exposed
visual_phrases.keyhole_neck: keyhole neckline with a deliberate small opening below the neckline
visual_phrases.collar_neck: structured collar attached around the neckline
visual_phrases.mandarin_collar: short upright mandarin collar standing around the base of the neck
